content: MK calls ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Bisṭāmī Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's younger counterpart in Anatolia, whose writings promise light on the shared project of Ṣāʾin al-Dīn, Sharaf al-Dīn and their 'Devoted Brethren'; he says Ṣāʾin al-Dīn often complains that his writings are prized in Anatolia and India while regressive but powerful scholarly factions make work in Iran hard.
